info.title: Neon Workspace API
info.description:
The HTTP API of Neon Workspace.

Every error response has the same body: `{"error": {"code": string, "message": string}}`. `code` is stable and meant for programs, such as `not_found` or `invalid_json`; `message` says what went wrong, for people. A request with several wrong fields, such as settings, also lists each in `problems`. A rate-limited request answers 429 with `Retry-After`.

A request authenticates with the session cookie that `POST /api/v1/auth/login` sets, or with `Authorization: Bearer nw_…`, an API token. A token's scopes decide what it may do: `read` for safe methods, `write` for the others, `admin` for `/api/v1/admin`. Deleting a workspace and transferring its ownership need a browser session. A request that changes something and carries no `Authorization` header must come from the server's own origin: its `Origin`, or else its `Referer`, must match the public URL.

get.summary: List the invitations waiting for the user
get.description: Invitations into workspaces that the user has not answered and that have not expired. Needs a session or an API token with the read scope.

post.description: Joins the workspace with the invitation's role, and its default teamspace unless as a guest. Needs a session or an API token with the write scope.

404.description: not_found: no such invitation waiting for the user.

409.description: already_member, or member_limit: the workspace is full; the invitation stays.

post.description: Needs a session or an API token with the write scope.

404.description: not_found: no such invitation waiting for the user.

get.description: Needs a session or an API token with the read scope.

patch.summary: Rename the signed-in user, or pin their hue
patch.description: Changes what the body names, all of it or, when any part is invalid, none. Needs a session or an API token with the write scope.

post.description: Needs the current password and a browser session; API tokens cannot. Signs out every other session, and mails the account that its password changed.

401.description: unauthenticated, or invalid_credentials: the current password is wrong.

get.summary: The web app's look for this user
get.description: Defaults for what the user never set. Needs a session or an API token with the read scope.

put.summary: Save the web app's look for this user
put.description: Replaces all four. Needs a session or an API token with the write scope.

get.description: Needs a session or an API token with the read scope.

200.description: The sessions that have not expired.

delete.description: Ends every session of the user but the current one. Only from a browser session.
Ends one of the user's sessions; ending the current one also clears its cookie. Only from a browser session.

get.description: Needs a session or an API token with the read scope.

post.description: Its secret is in this answer only; the server keeps its hash. A token never does more than its owner's role allows. Only from a browser session.

403.description: forbidden: not a browser session, or the admin scope for a user who is no admin.

delete.description: It stops working at once. Only from a browser session.

get.description: Each invite with who signed up with it. Codes are not listed: copy one with `GET /admin/invites/{id}/code`.

post.description: With an address, mails the invite there, naming the admin: the mail is queued with the invite, and `queued` is true.

409.description: invite_code_taken, or email_taken: the address has an account.

post.summary: Check a code as it is typed

get.description: Opens the code's sealed copy, which is kept while a secret key is configured.

409.description: code_unavailable: it was not kept, or its key is gone.

post.description: It admits no more sign-ups, and stays listed.

get.description: Only confirmed requests: an address must open its mailed link first.

post.description: Makes an invite bound to the request's address, for one sign-up, and mails it there, the mail queued with the invite. While mail is not set up the invite is made all the same, `queued` is false, and the code can be handed over.

404.description: not_found: no such request, or it is not waiting.

409.description: email_taken: the address has an account.

post.description: The address may ask again in 30 days, and is told so by mail while `auth.request_denied_mail` is on and mail is set up.

404.description: not_found: no such request, or it is not waiting.

post.description: Queues a test mail to the admin calling. Whether the mail server took it shows in the mail status of `GET /admin/settings`, with what it answered when it did not, and in the admin's inbox.

get.description: Every setting with its value, default and where the value comes from, and whether mail can go.

patch.description: Applies the changes together, at once and without a restart, or none of them: every value is checked, then the rules across settings. Settings pinned by the environment or the config file cannot change here. Secret settings need `secrets.keys`, as they are kept encrypted. Settings marked `browser_only` change only from a browser session.

403.description: forbidden, with a problem for each browser-only setting an API token tried to change; or insufficient_scope.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Accounts on the page, 1 to 200; 50 when absent.

post.description: Works whatever the registration mode, closed included. The address counts as verified. Only from a browser session: an API token invites people instead.

403.description: forbidden, as for an API token, or insufficient_scope.

patch.summary: Change an account's role, disable or enable it, or verify its address
patch.description: Changes only what the body names. The last admin who can sign in can be neither demoted nor disabled. A change of role or of the disable needs a browser session; an API token may only verify the address.

403.description: forbidden, as for an API token changing a role or the disable, or insufficient_scope.

post.summary: Mail an account its verification link again

204.description: The link was made and its mail queued.

429.description: rate_limited: one a minute, five a day.

get.description: Every workspace on the instance with its owners, member count, limits and usage. Nothing of what is in them.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Workspaces on the page, 1 to 200; 50 when absent.

delete.description: Deletes it with everything in it. Only from a browser session.

403.description: forbidden, as for an API token, or insufficient_scope.

patch.description: Changes the limits the body names. A workspace past a new limit keeps everyone in it, and takes no one more.

get.description: Which forms to show: the registration mode, and whether verification, password reset and requests to join are on, which also needs mail set up.

post.description: Says whether an invite admits sign-ups now, and the address it is bound to.

400.description: invalid_invite: used up, expired, revoked or none.

post.description: Mails the address a link to confirm the request; admins see it once it is confirmed. Answers the same whatever comes of it, so it tells nobody which addresses have accounts or requests.
Takes the token of the mailed link. The admins see the request from now.

400.description: invalid_link: used already, or too old.

post.description: Opens a browser session and sets its cookie: `neon_session`, or `__Host-neon_session` when the server's public URL is https; HttpOnly, SameSite=Lax, Path=/, Secure over https. An unknown address and a wrong password answer the same, and take as long; a disabled or unverified account is only told so after the right password.
Ends the current browser session and clears its cookie. With an API token, it ends nothing: revoke the token instead.

post.summary: Ask for a password reset link
post.description: Mails a link setting a new password to the account of the address, if it has one. Answers the same whether it has one or not.

post.summary: Set a new password with a mailed link
post.description: The link works once. It verifies the address and signs the account out of every session, but signs nobody in.
Signs up as the registration mode allows: anyone while it is open, with an invite while it is by invite, nobody while it is closed. Signs nobody in.
Mails a new link to the account of the address if it must still verify. Answers the same whether it has one or not.
Takes the token of the link mailed after signing up. The link works once. It signs nobody in: the password is still needed.

400.description: invalid_link: used already, or too old.

get.description: The instance's name and the server's version. Needs no authentication, so clients can check they reached a Neon server.

post.summary: Join a workspace by invite link
post.description: Using the link is accepting it: the caller joins with its role, and the default teamspace unless as a guest. Needs a signed-in account; links never make one.

400.description: invalid_invite_link: unknown, used up, expired or revoked.

post.summary: Look at an invite link before joining
post.description: The workspace an invite link admits to and the role it admits with, without using it, for the page that asks before joining. Needs a signed-in account. It takes from the allowance that joining takes from.

400.description: invalid_invite_link: unknown, used up, expired or revoked.

get.description: Each workspace the caller is in, with their role, slug and hue, and whether they may create one.

post.description: Makes the workspace with its default teamspace, General, and the caller as the owner of both. `workspaces.creation` may leave this to instance admins.

403.description: forbidden: only instance admins create workspaces here; or insufficient_scope.

409.description: slug_taken: another workspace has the slug given.

404.description: not_found: no such workspace, or the caller is not in it.

delete.description: Deletes it with everything in it, for an owner who types its name. Only from a browser session.

400.description: confirmation_mismatch: the name typed is not the workspace's.

403.description: forbidden: not an owner, or not a browser session; or insufficient_scope.

patch.description: Changes what the body names. For owners and admins.

get.summary: List the invitations waiting for an answer
get.description: For owners and admins.

post.description: Invites the account of an address, which accepts or declines under `/account/invitations`; nothing is joined before. It expires after 14 days. Invitations only go to existing accounts: an address without one answers `no_account`, and as that tells whether an address has an account, each inviter's invitations are rate-limited. For owners and admins.

400.description: invalid_input: the address is not one.

403.description: forbidden, as for an owner role, or insufficient_scope.

404.description: not_found: no such workspace; or no_account: no account here has the address.

409.description: already_member, already_invited, or member_limit: the workspace is full.

post.description: It can no longer be accepted. For owners and admins.

404.description: not_found: no such workspace, or no such pending invitation.

get.description: Without their tokens: copy one with `GET .../invite-links/{link_id}/token`. For owners and admins.

post.description: Whoever opens it signed in joins with its role, up to its number of uses, until it expires or is revoked. For owners and admins.

403.description: forbidden, as for a role other than member or guest, or insufficient_scope.

post.description: It admits nobody more, and stays listed. For owners and admins.

get.summary: Copy an invite link's token again
get.description: Opens the token's sealed copy, which is kept while a secret key is configured. For owners and admins.

409.description: token_unavailable: it was not kept, or its key is gone.

post.description: Leaves it and its teamspaces. The last owner cannot: they make another owner first, or delete the workspace. Nor can the last owner of one of its teamspaces, unless they own or administer the workspace: they make another owner of it first, or delete it.

get.description: Every member, or for a guest, only themselves.

delete.description: Takes them out of the workspace and its teamspaces. Owners remove anyone, admins anyone but an owner. To remove yourself, leave.

patch.description: Owners change anyone's role, owner included; admins anyone's but an owner's, and make no owners. A member who becomes a guest leaves every teamspace; a guest who becomes more joins the default one.

404.description: not_found: no such workspace or member.

409.description: last_owner: the workspace would have no owner.

get.summary: List the teamspaces the caller may see
get.description: With the caller's role in each. Private teamspaces show only to their members; the workspace's owners and admins also get their names.

post.description: Open, closed or private, with the caller as its owner. Owners and admins create teamspaces, and members too unless the workspace's `members_can_create_teamspaces` is off.

400.description: invalid_input, as for the default access.

get.description: A private teamspace answers `not_found` to everyone outside it, the workspace's owners and admins included.

delete.description: Any but the default one. For the teamspace's owners and the workspace's owners and admins, who delete a private one without being in it.

patch.description: Changes what the body names. For the teamspace's owners and the workspace's owners and admins, who join a private one first.

403.description: forbidden, as for the default teamspace's access, or insufficient_scope.

post.description: Any member joins an open teamspace. Closed and private ones take whom their owners add; the workspace's owners and admins may join them themselves, which is how they come to manage a private one.
Any but the default one. Its last owner may not, unless they own or administer the workspace.

get.description: For everyone who may see the teamspace: a private one's members are listed to its members only.

post.summary: Add a member to a teamspace
post.description: Any teamspace but the default one, which everyone is in. For the teamspace's owners and the workspace's owners and admins, who join a private one first. Guests are added to none.

403.description: forbidden, as for a guest, who is in no teamspace; or insufficient_scope.

404.description: not_found: no such teamspace, or the account is not in the workspace.

delete.summary: Remove a member from a teamspace
delete.description: Any teamspace but the default one. For the teamspace's owners and the workspace's owners and admins, who join a private one first.

patch.description: For the teamspace's owners and the workspace's owners and admins, who join a private one first. The last owner stays one unless an owner or admin of the workspace changes it.

post.description: Makes another member an owner and the owner calling an admin, together. Only from a browser session.

403.description: forbidden: not an owner, the member is one already, or not a browser session; or insufficient_scope.

404.description: not_found: no such workspace or member.

user_id.description: A member of the workspace who is not a guest.

After now and within a year; a week from now when absent.

hue_override.description: 0 to 359; the id's hue when absent.
0 to 359; the id's hue when absent.

A new invite with its code. The code is shown here, and again only from its sealed
copy when a secret key is configured.

For an invite meant to be mailed: whether its mail was queued, with the invite. It
is not while mail is not set up; the code can be handed over instead. Delivery

A new invite link with its token. The token is shown here, and again only from its

EffectiveLimits.description: The limits that hold for a workspace; absent is no limit.

members.description: The most people in it, guests included.

EmailRequest.description: An address, for the forms that answer the same whatever it is.

code.description: Stable and meant for programs, such as `not_found` or `invalid_json`.

problems.description: Each field that is wrong and why, when a request had several, such as settings.

code_kept.description: Whether its code can be copied again.

email.description: The address it is bound to, which alone signs up with it; absent for any address.

max_uses.description: How many sign-ups it admits, and how many it did.

signups.description: Who signed up with it, oldest first.

InviteCode.description: An invite's code, to copy again.

InviteCodeCheck.description: What keeps a typed code from making an invite.

problem.description: Its form, or another invite having it; absent when it can make one.

InviteLink.description: An invite link, without its token.

max_uses.description: How many people it admits, and how many joined with it.

role.description: What people join as: member or guest.

token_kept.description: Whether its token can be copied again.

oneOf.description:
The caller's role in the workspace when they are in it already, so joining would

role.description: What it admits as: member or guest.

by_email.description: Whether invites can be mailed now: switched on, and mail set up.

email.description: The address it is bound to, which the form fills in; absent for any address.

requests.description: Those waiting first, then those decided in the last 30 days.

note.description: For the admins, plain text, at most 500 characters.

JoinStatus.description: Where a request to join is.

effective.description: What holds: absent is no limit.

oneOf.description: The last delivery that failed, since the server started.

last_sent_at.description: When the mail server last took a mail, since the server started.

problem.description: What is missing, while it cannot go.

scopes.description: A session has every scope its role allows; a token, its own.

members.description: Owners first, then admins, members and guests, each by name.

name.description: The instance's name, from the `instance.name` setting.

Mode.description: Light or dark, or whichever the system prefers.

Person.description: An account as the people it works with see it.

hue.description: The hue they are drawn in, 0 to 359.

key.description: The field, such as a setting's key.

oneOf.description: Who invited them; absent once that account is gone.

role.description: What they would join as: admin, member or guest.

display_name.description: The address's local part when absent.

invite_code.description: Needed while registration is by invite.

Role.description: What an account may do on the instance.

invited_by.description: Who invited them; absent once their account is gone.

role.description: What they join as: admin, member or guest.

current.description: The session this request came with.

members.description:
The most people, guests included: 0 for no limit, null to follow the instance's

storage_bytes.description: The most bytes of attachments, likewise.

value.description: A secret shows as `[redacted]` when set, and empty when not.

slug.description: For URLs: lowercase letters, digits and dashes, unique on the instance.
